item.title: It looks like the DOJ isn’t going to break up Live Nation and Ticketmaster
item.description: The DOJ and Live Nation agreed to a tentative settlement, but dozens of state attorneys general don't want to drop the lawsuit.

item.title: Bluesky CEO Jay Graber steps down
item.description: Graber explained that, as a more mature company, Bluesky needs a "seasoned operator focused on scaling and execution." Graber said she feels better suited to building Bluesky's technology itself.

item.title: Anthropic launches code review tool to check flood of AI-generated code
item.description: Anthropic launched Code Review in Claude Code, a multi-agent system that automatically analyzes AI-generated code, flags logic errors, and helps enterprise developers manage the growing volume of code produced with AI.

item.title: OpenAI and Google employees rush to Anthropic’s defense in DOD lawsuit
item.description: More than 30 OpenAI and Google DeepMind employees signed onto a statement supporting Anthropic's lawsuit against the Defense Department after the agency labeled the AI firm a supply-chain risk, according to court filings.

item.title: Electric air taxis are about to take flight in 26 states
item.description: The federal government has selected eight proposals to test electric aircraft across 26 states.

item.title: Founders Fund nears $6B close for latest growth fund, sources say
item.description: The fresh fundraise comes less than a year after Founders Fund closed its third growth fund, a $4.6 billion vehicle intended primarily for follow-on investments in its successful late-stage companies.

item.title: Electric air taxi maker Archer hits back at Joby in countersuit alleging concealed Chinese ties
item.description: Archer's countersuit comes four months after Joby sued its rival for alleged 'corporate espionage.'

item.title: An iPhone-hacking toolkit used by Russian spies likely came from U.S military contractor
item.description: Google found a series of hacking tools they said were used by a Russian espionage group and a cybercriminal group in China. Sources from a U.S. government defense contractor said some of those hacking tools were theirs.

item.title: Yann LeCun’s AMI Labs raises $1.03 billion to build world models
item.description: AMI Labs, the new venture cofounded by Turing Prize winner Yann LeCun after he left Meta, has raised $1.03 billion at a $3.5 billion pre-money valuation.

item.title: Apple now makes one in four iPhones in India: report
item.description: Apple reportedly produced 55 million units in India last year, a shift accelerated as Apple faced growing uncertainty in China.
